title: Jailbreak Foundry: From Papers to Runnable Attacks for Reproducible Benchmarking

layout.note: Two input boxes sit top-left; below them the blue FORGE container, then the grey LIB and peach EVAL containers continue to the right in one row; a bus line under EVAL fans out to three result boxes along the bottom edge.

lesson: Give each system component its own tinted container and carry that tint onto the arrows that leave it; inside, white cards with a stock icon and a parenthesised input-output caption keep a dense system legible without step numbers. An offset stack of cards says 'many items' for a registry.
